title: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea
author: Jules Verne
summary: A French naturalist, his servant and a Canadian harpooner are captured by the enigmatic Captain Nemo and carried around the world in his extraordinary submarine. They see wonders and dangers beneath the waves.
readIf: you like old-fashioned voyages of discovery full of undersea marvels and a brooding captain.
skipIf: you dislike long catalogues of sea life and technical detail, which take up much of the book.

pairings.reason: The same author's lighter, brisker race around the globe, with a cheerful tone and quick pace.
Another obsessive captain and a sea voyage, though far heavier, stranger and more literary.
A modern ocean story that mixes wonder, danger and ideas about belief.
